top_signals.title: European Bank Stocks Head for Worst Two-Day Rout Since March
top_signals.summary: Banks have been Europe’s best-performing stocks for two years, and were on pace for stellar gains again in 2026. The return of French debt worries is threatening to thwart the rally.

top_signals.summary: Qatar National Bank has secured a $2.5 billion syndicated loan led mainly by Asian lenders, according to people familiar with the matter, signaling continued appetite to finance Gulf borrowers despite the regional war.
